vector_memory.semantic_summary: This component defines ShaderUniformsEnum, a TypeScript enumeration that serves as a centralized, type-safe registry for string constants representing GLSL shader uniform variable names. It acts as a critical configuration layer, bridging high-level application state (like camera position or material color) to low-level shader programs. By centralizing these string literals, it ensures consistency across the rendering pipeline, covering matrices, lighting parameters, texture samplers, and fog settings.
